Digital Twin for Asset Integrity in Tanzania — NDT Data on a Live 3D Model

Atlantis NDT Digital Twin gives integrity teams in Tanzania, Tanzania one 3D model of the asset with every UT, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT, PT and ET reading mapped to the exact location it was taken. Corrosion rates trend automatically, API 581 RBI scores update as data lands, and API 579-1/ASME FFS-1 Level 1 and Level 2 assessments run against measured thickness instead of a spreadsheet snapshot.

The Tanzania asset base this is built for

Dar es Salaam anchors Tanzania's energy sector through the Tanzania International Petroleum Reserves Limited (TIPER) refinery-turned-storage terminal and TANESCO's Kinyerezi gas-fired power plants, which rely on turbines and gas-handling vessels fed by domestic offshore production. Offshore Lindi and Mtwara, Shell, Equinor, and ExxonMobil hold deepwater gas blocks underpinning the planned Tanzania LNG project at Likong'o, a mega-development that will bring cryogenic liquefaction infrastructure to a coastline with little prior heavy-industry inspection capacity. Inland, gold mining operators Barrick (North Mara, Bulyanhulu) and AngloGold Ashanti (Geita) run large-scale ore-processing plants requiring sustained vessel and structural integrity monitoring under the Ministry of Minerals and PURA (Petroleum Upstream Regulatory Authority) oversight. Digital twins let Tanzania's gas, power, and mining operators consolidate NDT-backed 3D asset records ahead of the country's LNG buildout and across dispersed inland mine sites.

How the twin is built

Capture the geometry (LiDAR, photogrammetry, drone survey, or import your existing BIM/CAD and isometrics), ingest inspection data over REST API or file drop from any instrument, overlay the governing damage mechanisms per API RP 571, then publish colour-coded remaining-life and RBI views to integrity, maintenance and planning. Records are retained audit-ready under ISO 9001, ISO 17020 and ISO 17025.

Integrations

SAP PM, Oracle eAM, IBM Maximo, ServiceNow, AVEVA PI, OSIsoft historians, Bentley iTwin, Cognite and Atlantis NDT ERP. Full REST API and bulk data export — you keep your data in a format you can leave with.

Frequently Asked Questions

How does Atlantis Digital Twin work in Tanzania?

We start with a 3D scan of your asset (drone, laser, photogrammetry), build a CAD-fidelity model, and then overlay every NDT inspection event (UT thickness readings, TOFD/PAUT scans, MT/PT indications, RT defect maps). Inspection data updates the model in real-time and colour-codes condition zones for engineering review. Operators in Tanzania use this to drive faster turnaround scoping, automated FFS evidence, and audit-grade regulatory reporting.

What does Digital Twin NDT cost in Tanzania?

Atlantis Digital Twin is an affordable, accessible, fully customizable enterprise SaaS platform sized for up to 500 assets, with ASNT Level III consulting and unlimited NDT data ingest included. Enterprise tiers are available for multi-site fleets, and on-prem deployment is offered at the same price point. Request a Tanzania-specific quote and we will model your asset count and data-volume requirements.

How long does deployment take in Tanzania?

A typical first-asset deployment runs 8-12 weeks: 2 weeks model build, 2 weeks data integration, 2-4 weeks workflow configuration, 2 weeks user training. Multi-asset rollouts are sequenced asset-by-asset after the first deployment is live, with each subsequent asset typically taking 4-6 weeks once the platform is configured for your Tanzania site.

Which NDT standards does the platform support in Tanzania?

API 510 (pressure vessels), API 570 (piping), API 653 (storage tanks), API 579 FFS, API 581 RBI, ASME Section V articles 2/4/6/7, ISO 9712 personnel qualification, ASNT SNT-TC-1A, and local code requirements depending on Tanzania's regulatory environment. Custom reporting templates can be configured for any additional national or operator-specific code.

Can Atlantis Digital Twin integrate with our existing CMMS in Tanzania?

Yes. We support REST API hooks for IBM Maximo, SAP PM, IFS, Oracle EAM, and most major CMMS platforms. Work-order creation, asset master sync, anomaly hand-off into corrective work, and FFS evidence packaging for management-of-change submittals can all be automated, allowing your Tanzania integrity team to focus on engineering judgement rather than data entry.
